description.text:
Brilliant Counterattack (璀璨反击) was the second enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 29 September 2023 in six-card packs with two holos. Galarian Sirfetch'd V is on its cover.

It brought Ditto V and Ditto VMAX, Rusted Sword and Rusted Shield for Zacian V and Zamazenta V, Aromatic Grass Energy and Coating Metal Energy, and Flareon, Vaporeon and Jolteon, each of which, holding a Memory Capsule, cancels the Abilities of one type of Pokémon on both sides. Amazing Rares came back with Celebi, Yveltal and Jirachi, and Professor's Research and Boss's Orders appeared with new characters. Its main cards are numbered out of 59; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards run to 79.
